item.tib: bkra shis brgyad pa zhes bya ba
item.coloph: zhes pa nag mo'i 'bangs kyis bkod pa'i bkra shis brgyad pa rdzogs so/ /ces pa 'di ni rgya gar gyi snyan dang mkhan chen po nag mo'i 'bangs kyis mdzad pa'i bkris brgyad pa zhes bya ba 'di'i rgya dpe rgya gar nub phyogs kyi rnal 'byor pa chen po tsang ga yi zhes pa/ bod skad lha mo'i dpal zhes pas bsnams byon pa/ dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis bsgyur nas sum bi ta 'bri ba po ni dge slong dpal ldan grags pas bgyis nas phul ba'o/ bkra shis//phyi mo ltar gcig zhus
